mathematics.metric: G=(1/33) sum_j (L_j^T L_j)/u_j^2, from inherited row terms. G positive definite by inherited full-column-rank L. Build inverse columns as 33*w from inherited support_core(e_i,u,E,precision=0), where w=(L^T diag(u^-2)L)^-1 e_i. Verify G*Ginv=I exactly. This is a matrix representation/dual calculation, not a point-vector norm evaluator.
mathematics.center_operator: T=C^T G C. For s>=0, sG-T PSD iff ||C||_G^2<=s. Bracket true maximum generalized eigenvalue by max_i T_ii/G_ii and max_i[(Ginv*T)_ii+sum_{j!=i}|(Ginv*T)_ij|]. All eigenvalues of Ginv*T are real/nonnegative by similarity to a symmetric PSD matrix.
mathematics.center_lognorm: S=(GC+C^TG)/2. mG-S PSD iff mu_G(C)<=m. Generalized eigenvalue bracket is max_i S_ii/G_ii through max_i[(Ginv*S)_ii+sum_{j!=i}|(Ginv*S)_ij|]. Ginv*S is similar to a real symmetric matrix.
mathematics.bracket_refinement: Use exact midpoint PSD decisions for requested finite steps. PASS sets upper=mid; a verified negative witness sets lower=mid. Initial upper must have an exact PSD certificate, and the final upper must retain one. Default8,max12 steps. Interval width decreases by factor2 per nontrivial step; equal endpoints return immediately. Optional supplied s/m proposals are accepted only after PSD verification, otherwise preserve a negative quadratic witness.
mathematics.PSD: Exact rational symmetric LDL/Schur elimination with no tolerance. Positive pivot: complete square and Schur update. Zero pivot requires the remaining pivot row be zero. A negative pivot yields a negative quadratic witness. If zero pivot has off-diagonal h!=0 at j, choose tail x_j=1, x_k=-(S_jj+1)/(2h), other tail entries0; tail quadratic=-1. Lift through previously stored completed-square coefficients backwards. Return exact negative v^TAv or nonnegative pivots/factor evidence. Handles singular PSD matrices without rounding or hidden epsilon.
mathematics.interval_perturbation: J=C+E with |E_ij|<=R_ij, R>=0. beta_squared=sum_{i,k,j,l}|G_ik| |Ginv_jl| R_ij R_kl bounds tr(E^T G E Ginv)=||G^(1/2) E G^(-1/2)||_F^2 and hence ||E||_G^2. Compute the finite sum using sparse G/Ginv entries. Use inherited scale-aware scalar sqrt enclosure for beta. beta is a sufficient family bound, not a general exact box maximum.
mathematics.family_bounds: Jop=sqrt_upper(s_center)+beta_upper; mu=m_center+beta_upper. Triangle inequality and mu(C+E)<=mu(C)+||E||_G prove simultaneous bounds for every matrix in the declared box. Scalar sqrt precision default40,max128; preserve its existing relative error and exact-square behavior.
mathematics.PR90_bridge: Cached family J0 has mu0<=0, alpha=-mu0. Current family J has independently generated mu1 and alpha_prime=-mu1 when mu1<=0. Difference family center C1-C0, radius R0+R1 generates d_bound. For a0,a>0: omega=2a/(a+a0), qstar=|a-a0|/(a+a0), q=qstar+omega*a0*d_bound/(1+a0*alpha). q<1 certifies only the declared exact-inverse/exact-relaxation reference iteration; q>=1 is inconclusive. No commutation assumption. Native-scaled residual factor a/(1+a*alpha_prime), normalized residual factor1/(1+a*alpha_prime). Current alpha_prime and cached alpha remain distinct. Inverse-action and represented-relaxation errors remain external; native iteration certificate false.
